import importlib.metadata, json, os, pathlib, sys, time
root=pathlib.Path('/mnt/firecuda2/Claude/implementation-20260922/release-1510/restart-check')
home=root/'home';home.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for k in ('PYTHONPATH','SPACR_BENCHMARK_JSON','SPACR_TIMING_PROCESS_START'):
    os.environ.pop(k,None)
os.environ.update(HOME=str(home),XDG_CONFIG_HOME=str(home/'.config'),XDG_CACHE_HOME=str(home/'.cache'),SPACR_HOME=str(home/'.spacr'),SPACR_NO_SETUP='1',SPACR_NO_BACKDROP='1',SPACR_TIMING='1',SPACR_TIMING_IMPORTS='0',PYTHONNOUSERSITE='1')
from PySide6.QtCore import QTimer,QThread
from spacr import updater,restart_state
from spacr.qt import app as qt_app,run
assert importlib.metadata.version('spacr')=='1.5.1.0'
assert pathlib.Path(updater.__file__).is_relative_to(pathlib.Path(sys.prefix))
real_show=qt_app.MainWindow.show
real_launch=updater.launch_updated_app
record={}
def show(window):
    real_show(window)
    def finish():
        record['old_pid']=os.getpid()
        record['old_module']=getattr(window._stack.currentWidget(),'app_key','__home__')
        window._on_upgrade_done((0,'Actual candidate upgrade verified in upgrade.json'))
    QTimer.singleShot(1500,finish)
def launch():
    record['loop_level_at_spawn']=QThread.currentThread().loopLevel()
    assert record['loop_level_at_spawn']==0
    record['saved_restart']=restart_state.peek()
    assert record['saved_restart']
    record['command']=restart_state.command()
    assert record['command']==[sys.executable,'-m','spacr.qt']
    os.environ.update(SPACR_BENCHMARK_JSON=str(root/'child.json'),SPACR_BENCHMARK_RUN='actual-package-relaunch',SPACR_BENCHMARK_TIMEOUT_S='45',SPACR_BENCHMARK_HARD_TIMEOUT='1',SPACR_TIMING_LOG=str(root/'child.timing.txt'))
    record['child_pid']=real_launch()
    return record['child_pid']
qt_app.MainWindow.show=show
updater.launch_updated_app=launch
record['parent_exit']=run([])
assert record['parent_exit']==0 and record.get('child_pid'),record
(root/'parent.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
import psutil
child=psutil.Process(record['child_pid'])
record['child_cmdline']=child.cmdline()
try:
    record['child_exit']=child.wait(timeout=240)
except psutil.TimeoutExpired:
    child.terminate();child.wait(timeout=10)
    raise RuntimeError('Replacement GUI exceeded the bounded startup probe')
assert (root/'child.json').is_file(),record
receipt=json.loads((root/'child.json').read_text())
record['child_benchmark']=receipt
record['restart_consumed']=restart_state.peek() is None
(root/'relaunch.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k!='child_benchmark'},indent=2))
print('Child benchmark:',receipt.get('reason'),receipt.get('home_ready_s'),len(receipt.get('results',[])))
assert record['restart_consumed'] and record['child_exit']==0,record
